_comment: Historical entries may come from gX or the gameX lineage. reverse_commit reverses a fix diff reachable from --base; gameX-era fixes that no longer map to the current paths/APIs should be re-expressed as targeted replace mutations with source=gameX and a note. Every entry must be killed by the named gate/test.

entries.description: Historical digital-pad fallback read raylib trigger/middle slots instead of the left-face D-pad buttons.
entries.note: v0.42.3 D-pad fallback bug, re-expressed without removing gX_Input_Gamepad_SynthesizeDpad so the current unit suite can diagnose it.

entries.description: Historical console idle detection compared raw axes to zero, so a controller resting at -1 kept the shell awake.
entries.note: v0.42.3 idle calibration bug, re-expressed as the old absolute-axis check while keeping the stored neutral trace. Pilot kill is indirect: the console focus-target assertion fires before the idle assertion. Keep as a gate-ordering finding; a dedicated idle-only check should make the kill precise.

entries.description: Historical GUI editor tour kept a fixed 420x180 card, so 175% scale clipped/removed the button row.
entries.note: v0.42.5 tour fix, scale half re-expressed as a fixed 1.0 scale mutation.

entries.description: Historical GUI editor tour placed SameLine after a conditional Back button, pushing Next off the card on step 0.
entries.note: v0.42.5 tour fix, button-row half re-expressed with the trace kept for a behavioral assertion.

entries.description: gameX-lineage tangent generation read past an indexed quad / partial soup boundary.
entries.note: The gX fix 4288636 closed the lineage boundary; reversing only the backend code keeps the current boundary test, which aborts with free(): invalid size. expect_crash records a contained signal kill, not a clean assertion.

entries.description: gameX R-2 class: float uniforms uploaded as int, producing a named type mismatch.
entries.note: The uniform-trace gate names the mismatch instead of leaving a black/incorrect render. Keeps the public helper and only changes the declared format.
